title: OrbitChain Event: donation_received
description: Emitted after every successful donation, once storage has been updated. Topics: ["donation_received", contract_address]

amount.description: Donated amount in base units, encoded as a decimal string

asset.description: Asset selector: "Native" for XLM, or a Stellar token contract address

new_total_raised.description: Cumulative raised amount after this donation, encoded as a decimal string

ledger.description: Ledger number at which the donation was processed
